# Example: pick an item, look at it, finish

## Brief
A person opens a short list, picks one item, reads it on its own screen and finishes — the
smallest journey that still shows every part of the method: an entry screen, a link carried by
`data-go`, a value typed on screen one that appears on screen three, the four states on every
screen, and one variant (`detail--dense`) to compare against its base.

## Targets
none — it is built from the system in `design/` and nothing else.

## Screens
### list — The list
**Composed from:** page, stack, heading, field, input, card, badge, button, skeleton, empty
### detail — One item
**Composed from:** page, stack, heading, card, badge, button, skeleton, empty
### done — Done
**Composed from:** page, stack, heading, card, button, empty
